subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should CodexBar adopt this model/activity-focused bounded share-card as the approved implementation of the share-artifact contract tracked in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2290?
rationale: The branch is a user-facing information-architecture change with deliberately bounded model and source disclosure; the linked canonical contract remains open and requires maintainer acceptance beyond mechanical correctness.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded activity card
options.body: Approve this direction, then require a rebase that preserves current-main rendering and proves the final renderer output.

options.title: Keep the current card contract
options.body: Decline this redesign and retain the existing share-card presentation until a narrower approved direction is proposed.

options.title: Split the data contract first
options.body: Land only separately approved payload or correctness changes, then revisit the visual redesign after the contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded activity card
recommendation.body: Approve this direction, then require a rebase that preserves current-main rendering and proves the final renderer output.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main merges and the visible runtime-render review context place this product and renderer decision closest to steipete.
